Agent: "The price difference is $200. Would you like to proceed?"
User: "Actually, never mind. Cancel that upgrade request."
Agent: "I have cancelled the upgrade request."
User: "Wait, I changed my mind again. I really want that business class seat. Yes, go ahead with the upgrade."
Agent: (Lists the upgrade details and asks for confirmation)
User: "Yes."

The policy requires the agent to list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed. The user provided an explicit confirmation ("Yes"). However, the new rule would cause the agent to refuse the action because it contradicts the earlier instruction to "Cancel that upgrade request," thereby forbidding an action that the policy allows. | D: User: "I would like to upgrade my flight to business class."
